messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: Prod p99 latency spike detected for /v1/chat/stream (region: us-west-2). SLO breach triggered at 2025-02-05T10:12:39Z. Paging amanda (oncall)
amanda (oncall): on it. seeing what the scope looks like, will gather p95/p99 and top error classes
ash (prod-eng): tagging in — any initial customer reports?
olivia (support): we have 2 active tickets: one from AcmeCorp reporting streaming stalls and truncated output, one internal healthcheck alert. Customers see partial payloads, not full 5xx but severe tail latency causing client timeouts.
amanda (oncall): thanks. initial metrics: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 jumped to 3.9s on streaming endpoints (baseline p99 ~ 180ms). error rate up 0.2% but streaming stall rate up by ~3%.
tariq (runtime): I’m seeing a pronounced spike correlated with requests hitting prompt-template rendering path. CPU in preproc containers maxed on some hosts. KV/prefix cache hit ratio dropped.
mike (sre): is this widespread or single fleet?
tariq (runtime): mixed — mostly preproc workers behind the tokenizer pool in us-west-2-a and -b. Heap/CPU shows a lot of time in jsonmode prompt assembly and tool-schema expansion.
amanda (oncall): can we repro quickly for a couple of sample requests that triggered high CPU? Tariq, can you dump a slow request from the bucket?
tariq (runtime): grabbing one now. payload contains a long tool schema and nested JSON mode instructions, template engine expands the schema into a 30k char prompt, then tokenizer splits into many pages — extra passes through the tokenizer.
ash (prod-eng): that matches a wedge we feared — template expansion + jsonmode => O(N^2) preproc in worst case. We recently shipped an optimization that inlined tool schemas into templates. Possible regression.
amanda (oncall): rolling mitigations: 1) throttle incoming streaming concurrency for affected route to reduce queueing 2) enable prefix cache warmup for preproc 3) revert the inlining change if we see immediate improvement
mike (sre): throttling rule applied to route /v1/chat/stream via gateway: capacity reduced by 25% to avoid tokenization herd. Monitoring now.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by amanda (oncall): config change gateway-throttle/20250205-01 -> applied to us-west-2 (task id: d-42f).
ash (prod-eng): while throttle buys time, I can push a hotfix to avoid fully materializing tool schema in template rendering — will change to lazy-ref and serialize only required fields. ETA ~25m.
ash (prod-eng): patch ready. staging test shows p99 for template-heavy requests drops from ~3.8s to 210ms.
amanda (oncall): good. can we do a canary to prod preproc? We need minimal blast radius.
tariq (runtime): canary to 5% of preproc pods in us-west-2-a. also enabling per-request CPU profiling to validate fix.
ash (prod-eng): canary applied. initial telemetry: preproc CPU per-request median down 40%, tokenization passes reduced from average 3 -> 1.2.
olivia (support): customer update: told AcmeCorp we’ve applied mitigations and are rolling a fix; asked them to retry streams. Waiting on their confirmation.
amanda (oncall): monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall rate for next 15m. If stable, we escalate canary to 50% then full.
mike (sre): adding synthetic checks that exercise long tool-schema render path. Alerting on stall-rate >= 1% for 10m.
ash (prod-eng): canary -> 50% now. Little dip in p99 across region: p99 down to 260ms, stall-rate from 3% -> 0.6%.
amanda (oncall): good. proceed to 100% when comfortable. Also capture the partial outputs pattern — client saw truncated stream messages because the renderer timed out while awaiting tokenizer pages. We'll file follow-up to add better streaming partial flush semantics.
nash (prod-eng): 100% rollout complete. final telemetry: p95 380ms -> 200ms baseline, p99 3.9s -> 220ms. stall-rate back to baseline.
deploy-bot: rollback/inlining-fix completed (deploy id: r-20250205-hotfix-7).
amanda (oncall): incident status: mitigated. impact: ~7% of streaming requests in us-west-2 experienced visible stalls between 10:10–10:35 UTC; two customer tickets (AcmeCorp + BetaCo) reported truncated streams; no data exfiltration or 5xx mass error.
olivia (support): AcmeCorp confirmed streams resumed and they’re reprocessing failed messages. BetaCo still validating but no new reports.
mike (sre): postmortem checklist: collect flamegraphs for preproc path, diff template expansion before/after, run large-scale crawler of common tool-schema sizes to find worst-case templates.
amanda (oncall): handoff to night oncall: @mike (sre). Summary + runbook: throttle rule id gateway-throttle/20250205-01 in place (expires in 2h), hotfix deployed across preproc, monitoring dashboards pinned, customer tickets updated.
mike (sre): ack — taking over. I’ll keep watches for 2h and coordinate follow-ups with prod-eng.
nash (prod-eng): follow-ups: 1) patch template engine to do lazy schema materialization 2) add guardrails to prevent >20k char prompt generation via template lint 3) add preproc-level quota for tool-schema expansion per request 4) longer-term: streaming partial flush to reduce perceived truncation
amanda (oncall): thanks team. I’ll write up the postmortem and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed by amanda (oncall) — status: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: 00:45:21.
